name: Fermented pork parcel
summary: Vietnam.vn, 6 February 2026, calls tré a Gia Lai specialty of the former Bình Định area: chopped pork, ear, and skin, wrapped in leaf and then in straw, fermented two or three days.
origin: Vietnam.vn, 6 February 2026, bylined VietNamNet. The article keeps the old Bình Định geography inside the merged province.
howToEat: Boil and chop the pork head. Fry belly. Mix with pepper, galangal, toasted sesame, seasoning, roasted rice powder, and garlic. The article says the mix varies by village.
Wrap it in banana leaf or mature guava leaf, then plastic, then a sheaf of straw tied so the straws cover the parcel.
It ferments on its own. After two or three days it is lightly sour and smells of galangal and garlic.
where: The former Bình Định area, which the article now files under Gia Lai. A street is Check on arrival. An hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Tré — fermented pork from former Bình Định
seoDescription: Tré is fermented pork, ear, and skin in leaf and straw. Vietnam.vn calls it a Gia Lai specialty of former Bình Định. A price is Check on arrival.
